about_short_description.short_description: SaturnX enables businesses and financial institutions to move money globally through an API-first platform.

product.name: SaturnX Payments powered by Stablecoins
product.description: A stablecoin-based payments infrastructure enabling global money transfers through blockchain technology.

product.name: Universal Conversion Layer
product.description: An API layer that accepts fiat or stablecoins, converts or swaps assets across blockchains, and disburses funds in local currencies or bank accounts.

product.name: Seamless API Integration
product.description: A developer-friendly REST API with real-time webhooks for quick integration of SaturnX’s payment infrastructure into existing systems.

product.name: Powerful Dashboard for Total Control
product.description: A real-time dashboard for tracking balances, monitoring payouts, and generating reports within the SaturnX payment system.
